Input role: the supplied eight-resident lineup is OUR canonical design reference. Select ONLY the SECOND character from the left, RYO. Preserve his identity and everyday costume.

All three views show the same wavy dark-brown swept quiff, adult angular anime face, gently defined jaw, indigo open buttoned overshirt with rolled sleeves over an ivory crew-neck T-shirt, beige straight full-length trousers, ivory lace-up sneakers. Prioritize clean modeling-readable forms, like modern Trails in the Sky the 1st/the 2nd visual language, using only our original character. No photographic cloth weave, fuzzy surfaces, plastic doll look or painterly brush texture.
